title: DeVonta Smith listed as limited in Eagles practice, Saquon Barkley still out

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: DeVonta Smith listed as limited in Eagles practice, Saquon Barkley still out
sources.description: The Eagles announced on Thursday that quarterback Jalen Hurts will not play against the Panthers due to a blood clot in his calf, which leaves Tanner McKee in line to make the first non-Week 18 start of his career.
